summary: Iteration 4 - Auto-Pause on High Risk backend testing. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_auto_pause.py (15 test cases across 3 classes) covering candidate proctor-event auto-pause, admin manual pause/unpause, 403/404 negative cases, paper paused reflection, HTTP 423 submit guard, unpause->submit success, admin risk_by_candidate paused/submitted flags, and regression on login + analytics dashboard. All 15/15 tests passed. Test data (blueprints/exams/papers) cleaned up after the run.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_pause / admin_unpause don't verify the exam actually exists - they only check papers.matched_count. If an exam exists but the candidate never joined, the endpoint returns 404 with reason 'Paper not found' which mixes 'unknown exam' and 'unknown candidate' cases. Consider explicit exam lookup for clearer error semantics (currently acceptable and matches spec).
log_proctor_event returns 400 'You have not joined this exam' when paper missing; spec allows this but might be better as 404.
Auto-pause sets paused_at but unpause endpoint doesn't clear paused_at - stale timestamp remains. Minor data hygiene.
seed_data_creation: Test blueprints/exams prefixed TEST_ created and deleted within fixtures. Existing 365-question bank used as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pause endpoints verified end-to-end. All 15 tests pass in ~3s. Prior iteration_1 backend_test.py suite was NOT rerun per request. If needed, run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_auto_pause.py -v
